description: Every other gang command, its flags as separate items (gang_help lists them all): create (V3; create --fair = fair mint; create --fly = Mint Flywheel; launch in one command with --dev-buy / --bond / --buyback / --split / --lp, several of the last three = one combined recipient), mint (--ref <inviter> on a Mint Flywheel token), withdraw, claim, release, fly open-early|launch|invite, quote, list, upload-logo, bond post|topup|raise-hold|extend|status|start|report|settle|refund|burn|tx, buyback status|set|set-payee|apply|bind|release|split|sweep, split status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind, lp status|set|set-payee|apply|bind|release|split|sweep|add, combo status|distribute|release|set-payee|bind|chunk, creator-fee [--token] [--claim [--to]] (GangLaunchpad 2.0 / 3.0: 70% of the curve fee, kept for the creator), v3 income, version, capabilities; the flags no other tool takes (--calldata, --from, …) too. E.g. ["create","--name","My Token","--symbol","MYT","--logo","/Users/me/avatar.png"], ["bond","status","--token","0x…"]. Local files are read by this server: absolute paths, or --logo-uri <image URL>. Writes only preview, as above. execute / watch / help have their own tools.
name: gang_cli
title: Other gang commands
